Niamh (CS): Heads-up  we're seeing delayed onboarding completion for a small group of private tenants after last night's index deploy. A few customers are emailing renewals teams worried about go-live. Need an embargoed customer note, per-tenant ETA, and a renewal-risk flagging flow.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-721 created  onboarding index backlog after deploy. Bridge: https://bridge.redwood.ai/INC-2026-721.

Omar (SRE): Root cause: a change to batching during the deploy increased tail latency for small index jobs; we've reverted that change at 02:05 UTC and started a priority reprocess queue. Most jobs will clear; ~18% hit a checkpoint state that needs manual resume.

Ben (Eng): Requeue started 02:12 UTC. Bulk resume tool in smoke test, ETA ~90m for manual resumes. Will upload runbook + per-tenant ETA CSV to /shared/cs/onboard-backlog-4925.csv.

Niamh (CS): Draft short external blurb for high-touch: 'We identified and reverted an indexing change that affected some private onboarding jobs. Engineering is reprocessing work now; most tenants will recover within 3 hours. Your CS rep will send a tenant-specific ETA and support options, including an expedited onboarding clinic and credits for materially affected accounts.' Thoughts?

Leah (SE): Add safety reassurance: 'No customer model weights or raw data were deleted or exposed.' Also I'll prepare FR/ES translations and a short Slack DM variant.

Ravi (CS Manager): Approve message. Compensation proposals: opt-in 1-week dedicated capacity credit OR one-time $600 onboarding credit OR a prioritized 1:1 onboarding clinic (choose one). Also propose a 2-hour exec office hours session for any customers flagged as renewal-risk.

Niamh (CS): We need a renewal-risk triage: if onboarding progress <50% after 6 hours, auto-flag renewal-risk and route to GTM with a short summary. Ravi  can you own escalation?

Ravi (CS Manager): I'll own escalation. Also please add an "exec outreach" checkbox in the CSV so we can track which accounts want direct exec contact.

Omar (SRE): Support diagnostic to include in the canned reply: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/<tenant>/onboard/status` returns state,last_error,job_ids. If state=="checkpointed" include job_ids in the ticket for manual resume.

Niamh (CS): I'll send priority emails after attaching the CSV + ETA column in 10m. Will paste the Zendesk canned reply here and capture opt-ins. We'll collect feedback via a short survey link in the clinic follow-up and append notes to the CSV. Posting final sent copy and list of reached tenants here once done. Thanks all :heart:
